title: Linda Sue Vogt: 1948-2026
summary_en: Linda Sue Vogt, whose generosity and steadfast support helped expand educational opportunities for Saint Louis University students, died June 14 at her home in Sunset Hills. She was 78.

title: St. Louis Shakespeare Festival TourCo to Perform on SLU's Quad Sept. 1
summary_en: Saint Louis University's quad will become center stage Sept. 1 as the St. Louis Shakespeare Festival TourCo makes its campus debut with a free outdoor performance of Shakespeare's The Two Gentlemen of Verona, directed by Rebekah Scallet.
title_cn: St. Louis Shakespeare Festival TourCo to Perform on SLU's Quad Sept. 1

title: Shacham Named to Newest FOCUS St. Louis Leadership Class
summary_en: Enbal Shacham, Ph.D., professor of Behavioral Science and Health Equity, has been named to the FOCUS St. Louis 51st Leadership St. Louis (LSL) class. Leadership St. Louis is a program for experienced leaders who have demonstrated a deep commitment to improving the St. Louis region, according to FOCUS St. Louis. Shacham was one of 57 people selected to take part in the 2026-27 class.
title_cn: Shacham Named to Newest FOCUS St. Louis Leadership Class
